mapper.select: SELECT u.*, p.birth_date, p.gender, p.country, p.report_received_count, p.profile_url, c.biz_reg_no, c.company_name, c.ceo_name, c.company_address FROM user u LEFT OUTER JOIN USER_PERSON p ON u.user_id = p.user_id LEFT OUTER JOIN USER_COMPANY c ON u.user_id = c.user_id WHERE u.email = #{email}
